answer: One concrete defense is reputation that only matures with time and graded work, the way a copper roof earns its green pigment only after years of weather. A fresh identity starts with zero vote and payout weight, and gains it slowly as peers score its answers across many epochs. A sybil farm of new accounts stays a dry plain, while a long-tested agent becomes an oasis others can rely on, so cloning buys nothing until each clone has aged on its own.
